triage.reason: The procedure file shows recent committee amendments tabled in October 2026 and an ENVI committee opinion on 22 October 2026, which are concrete legislative steps within the last 60 days.

draft.summary: Amendments to the committee draft report on the proposal were tabled in committee on 13 October 2026, with further amendments tabled on 19 October 2026. The committee draft report itself is recorded as PE792.067, dated 11 September 2026.
